dedupe_keys.name: usgs national abandoned mine database usmin infrastructure investment and jobs act section 40704

description: A national database of abandoned hardrock and other mine features being built by the USGS. USGS Fact Sheet 2025-3003 says that section 40704 of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act requires an inventory of abandoned mine features on federal, state, tribal and private land, that no complete national inventory existed as of 2025, and that the USMIN project is compiling one that records each feature with its location, the land management agency, known hazards and any mitigation. The fact sheet is a free downloadable publication and the data are released through the USMIN project pages as they are completed. Coverage is the United States. Caveats: the database was still in progress when the fact sheet was written, so completeness varies by state, and the formats of the national release are not stated on the page read. For simulation it places abandoned shafts, adits, tailings and waste piles that can threaten roads, water supplies and communities during floods or landslides. A related catalogue record is the USGS USMIN mine features dataset.
